plainTranslation: A's structure meets B's growth. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility sit right on top of your judgment about what's possible.
summaryDeep: Their standards, caution, and sense of responsibility sit right on top of your judgment about what's possible. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
